recent_en: OPENSYS announced its quarterly results on 16 Nov 2026 and declared a fourth interim dividend of 0.45 sen per share. News reported that its 3Q2026 revenue jumped 82.9% year-on-year on CRM rollouts. The company also issued notices for ex-dividend and payment dates.
